Truly............ not in the slightest.

Afterward, continuing to stroll through the park and feeling soothed by the lovely blossoms...
I felt like I could understand a bit of her deep love for flowers.
Well then... how about we swap and share our water?

I just got carried away wanting you to learn so much about flowers...
...I was being rather forceful, wasn't I?

Ah—that's right, the nemophilas!
Trainer, let's go look for them...!

Ah—fufu, that's true.
We did wait quite a long time before we could finally see the flowers.
Even those expectations—were completely and effortlessly surpassed.

Oh my—you did too, Trainer?
What a wonderful coincidence.
—Fufu. Thank you very much.
I'm sure the ride will fly by just as quickly this time too.

Excuse me... Trainer, aren't you hot?
We've been talking so much, so here, a drink—
But—it wasn't painful in the slightest.

Ah............
...I-I'm sorry. Since you said you were interested in flowers, I—

A lot of unexpected things have happened, but... maybe it's fate.
Besides, I'm sure there's plenty I can learn from looking at flowers with her.
(Chirp, chirp...)

Yes—of course.
Since we're here, let's take our time and chat.

—Fufu, indeed.
The flowers in bloom change with the seasons, after all.

—!
...Um, in that case—

Curren Bouquetd'or, tending to flowers all by herself.
Even if all I could do was watch over her, as her Trainer—

I'm terribly sorry, but the lighting inspection is taking longer than scheduled...
It looks like it will be about another hour before we can open the gates...
...Even if it's not about flowers.

Are those yellow flowers gerberas, I wonder...?
And I can see red poppies in the back, too—!
Ah............ Ah—is that so...?

Yes—I'm looking forward to it, too.
—Well then, shall we get on the bus?

...Fufu, yes.
—I can't wait.

I'm sure you'll love the nemophilas too.
Just like kingfishers, they're lovely, delicate little blue flowers—!

Talking with you, Trainer—
made the scenery here feel so much more vivid in my mind. And—
—Ah.

That went by faster than I thought...
I'm sorry, I feel like I did all the talking.

Unfortunately, though—it seems the bus schedule has temporarily
changed, so we'll have to wait a while.

I-Is that so? What a relief... Um—
Once we get there, I'd love to search for the nemophilas with you.

That didn't take long at all, did it? Shall we head over, then?
We've finally arrived at today's destination.
...Um, Trainer.
If it's alright with you—would you like to chat some more?

On the way back—please tell me your thoughts, Trainer.
About the flowers you came to like today. And—

Ah... over there, there's a kingfisher.
Such a lovely lapis lazuli blue—it's so adorable.

Ah—in that case, I'll go grab a brochure.
Let's read it over on that bench.

Trainer... what should we do?
I don't mind waiting, but—

That being said, we have to wait for the bus again...
It looks like it will still be quite some time before we get back.

Oh—is that so?
...Fufu, I see.

—Trainer?
What brings you... all the way out here?
Ah... I was just wondering if you were hot, Trainer...

And so, the two of us waited for the bus while talking.
By the time we finally arrived near the academy, the sun was beginning to set, but—

And so, after swaying along on the bus, we finally
reached the botanical garden's reception, but...

I heard there was a gorgeous flower field here, so I've been curious for a while...
It's far from the academy, though, so this is my first time coming.

Wow—there they are, Trainer!
Look, so many tiny flowers—they're truly adorable.

Sorry to keep you waiting!
The inspection is finished, so you may enter now.

The bus back... is in about 20 minutes.
Looks like we won't have to wait as long as on the way here.
The sunset we looked up at together—somehow felt more beautiful than usual.

Autumn—along with the autumn leaves, of course—is when
vibrant blossoms like dahlias and cosmos burst into bloom.

The turning of the seasons takes time, but—
there are so many joys to look forward to within it.

And even in the harsh winter—beautiful flowers quietly bloom.
Seeing camellias and cyclamens—warms my heart.

With that in mind, today I was heading to a botanical garden in the next town, famous for its flowers.
When I arrived at the nearest bus stop, there stood—

I take a plastic bottle out of my bag that I had bought at reception.
Thinking she must be thirsty, I hold it out to her—
Here, I got this at the reception earlier—huh?

Amazing...!
Every single one—is so vividly colorful...!

It's already starting to get dark, isn't it?
Even though the sun was shining so brightly just a little while ago—

—Around this time of year, roses should be in full bloom too.
And azaleas, along with lavender—oh?

Most botanical gardens like this replant their flowers each season.
'Experience the shifting seasons through flowers,' it says—
